answer: The wander holds work receipts rather than names, so the karst of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the haven of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on invitation quota tree, taxed when attestations come from one subnet. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
